root_cause: Original incident audit deduplicated by provider event ID plus fingerprint, permitting contradictory classifications of one source event, and selected the first recovery receipt even if another record contradicted it.
fix: One original pure reconciler now pre-scans provider event ID collisions across fingerprints and rejects multiple matching recovery receipts before reporting any verified recovery.
prevention_rule: One provider event ID must resolve to one source-backed fingerprint and one canonical independently verifiable recovery. Disagreement creates an open identity incident; never select favorable evidence or claim global green.

invariants: same provider ID never yields two proven incident identities
competing recovery receipts never result in proven recovery
source coverage missing never looks green

terminal_rule: Exact-head Required, full BRAIN, CodeQL, protected merge, original runtime readback, portal and next natural run. Not a promise of all-agent incident coverage.
